items.name: hooks
items.title: Hooks
items.description: Shared hooks: controllable state, reduced-motion detection, the Android press ripple, Android back-button handling for overlays and the surrounding Form’s status.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: Small shared helpers used by several components.

items.name: charts
items.title: Chart internals
items.description: Shared by the charts: the frame (legend, tooltip, table view), scales, axes and the SVG layer for web and native.

items.name: provider
items.title: UniversalProvider
items.description: Root provider: Tamagui config, color mode, icons, toasts, global styles.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: A line chart with a light wash under each line, for totals and stacked parts over time.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Compares values across categories as columns or bars, grouped or stacked.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: Shows change over an ordered axis, such as months, as one or more lines.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: Part-to-whole at a glance, as a donut or pie with up to six slices.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: A spreadsheet-like grid: move between cells with the arrow keys and edit values in place, with validation.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A table driven by data and columns, with sorting, search, row selection and pagination.

items.name: kpi-card
items.title: KPI Card
items.description: A card for one key figure on a dashboard, with its change and an icon.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One figure with its label, how it changed and a short note.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns of data, with sortable headers, stripes and sideways scrolling.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events in order along a vertical line, such as an activity feed or order history.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: A hierarchy of items that open and close, such as folders or place codes.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked sections that expand to reveal their content, such as FAQs or grouped settings.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Interrupts the user to confirm an important or destructive action before it happens.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message that draws attention without interrupting the task.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps content at a fixed width-to-height ratio as the width changes, for images, video and maps.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: Plays a sound with a play button, a seek bar, skip buttons and a speed control, the same on every platform.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: A text field with suggestions; any text is a valid value.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A profile image with an automatic initials fallback.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for status, counts or categories.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up to each level.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Groups related buttons, joined into one control or spaced apart, such as a split button or a set of actions.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range, with limits and disabled days.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface that groups related content and actions.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Lets users select one or more options, or toggle a single setting before submitting.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A compact element for a filter, an entered value such as a recipient, or a suggested action.

items.name: circular-progress
items.title: Circular Progress
items.description: A ring that fills as a task completes, for tight spaces and dashboards. Without a value it spins.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides a section with one trigger, such as "Show 3 more" or "Advanced options".

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A select you can type in to filter long lists of options.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A searchable list of actions in a dialog, opened with ⌘K or Ctrl+K.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Actions for an area, opened with a right-click on desktop and a long-press on touch screens.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A field that opens a calendar in a popover, or a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: A field that opens a range calendar: pick a start, then an end.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window for focused tasks that require the user’s attention.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, for navigation, filters or details.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A list of actions or options that opens from a button.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A placeholder for an empty list, search or page, with the action that fills it.

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error State
items.description: Shown in place of content that failed to load, with a retry button.

items.name: fab
items.title: Floating Action Button
items.description: The primary action of a screen, such as Compose or New, floating above the content.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: A large area to drop files on (web) or tap to pick them, with the files listed below.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A button that opens the file picker, with the picked files listed below.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: A label, one control, help text and an error message, wired together.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Lays out a form, with an optional title, description and footer, and wires up submit, loading and disabled states. Field state and validation stay with your app or form library.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card that appears when a pointer rests on a link or keyboard focus reaches it.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A square, icon-only button for compact toolbars and headers.

items.name: image-gallery
items.title: Image Gallery
items.description: A grid of thumbnails that open a viewer with previous and next.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: A picture in a box of a set size or ratio, with a placeholder and a fallback.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible label linked to a form control.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: Centers page content with a max width and responsive side padding.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Equal-width responsive columns that work identically on web and native.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Flexbox primitives: Box, Stack, HStack, VStack, Center and Spacer.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A vertical list of rows with a leading visual, text and trailing meta.

items.name: loading-button
items.title: Loading Button
items.description: A button that displays a loading indicator and prevents interaction while an asynchronous action is in progress.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: An always-visible list of actions or destinations, with icons, groups and a selected item.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Pick several options from a searchable list; picks show as chips.

items.name: navigation-bar
items.title: Navigation Bar
items.description: Switches between three to five top-level destinations of an app, at the bottom of the screen on phones.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with links and buttons that open panels of more links.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A numeric field with − and + buttons, limits and a step.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time-code field drawn as separate slots, with paste and SMS autofill.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous and next buttons around the page numbers of a long list or table.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a button that shows and hides the text.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Rich, interactive content anchored to a trigger, such as quick settings, filters or a short form.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how much of a task is complete.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually exclusive options where exactly one can be selected.

items.name: resizable-panel
items.title: Resizable Panel
items.description: Panels side by side or stacked, with handles to drag, or move with the arrow keys, to resize them.

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich Text Editor
items.description: A Markdown editor with a formatting toolbar and a preview, plus Rich Text Content to show what was written.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A box that scrolls its content within a set height or width. On web its scrollbars are thin and in the theme colors.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: A search field with a magnifier, a clear button and a loading state.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one option from a list — a dropdown on desktop, a bottom sheet on touch devices.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin line that divides content horizontally or vertically.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen for extra actions, details or a short form.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App navigation down the side of the screen, collapsible to an icon rail.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder that previews the shape of loading content.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number, or a range, by dragging a thumb along a track.

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: A brief message at the bottom of the screen about something the app did, with an optional action like Undo.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a multi-step flow, such as a form wizard or checkout.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between related panels of content within the same view.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field for longer input.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Hour, minute and optional AM/PM selects that produce an "HH:mm" time.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief, non-blocking notifications triggered imperatively with `toast()`.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggle buttons: pick one, like text alignment, or turn on several, like bold and italic.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays on or off, such as Bold in a text toolbar.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint shown when an element is hovered or focused.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Text, Heading and Kbd components built on the type scale and semantic colors.

items.name: video
items.title: Video
items.description: A video with the platform’s own controls, a fixed aspect ratio, captions on web and an error state.
